ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMEROVERALLCREDITRATING_CRM] AS
BEGIN
-------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating
AS(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId, PeriodStartDate, SourceCode,FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY TMDATE) RN, * FROM (
	SELECT
  BCM.TMDATE
	 ,BCM.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
    ,BCM.DTDATE1 AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BCM.STRTEXT21 AS CreditRiskId
    ,BCM.STRTEXT27 AS CustomerCreditRatingNote
    ,BCM.STRTEXT20 AS RiskRatingTypeId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
    ,BCM.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID
    ,BCM.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
	FROM BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO BCM
	WHERE TYPE = 'Risk_Type'
	AND BCM.isLatest = '1' 

UNION ALL

    SELECT 
    BCC.TMDATE
	 ,BCC.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
    ,BCC.DATE1 AS PeriodStartDate
    ,BCC.STR21 AS CreditRiskId
    ,BCC.STR27 AS CustomerCreditRatingNote
    ,BCC.STR20 AS RiskRatingTypeId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CORP_MISC_ID
    ,BCC.SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
	FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO  BCC
	WHERE  TYPE = 'Risk_Type'
	AND BCC.isLatest = '1' 

  )a
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CreditRiskId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerCreditRatingNote)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,RiskRatingTypeId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId,  FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating
)
--SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMERID) FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_SRC
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CreditRiskId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerCreditRatingNote)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,RiskRatingTypeId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode 
FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating WHERE SOURCECODE = 'CRM' AND (PeriodEndDate  = '9999-12-31')
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
	,CASE
		 WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL OR TGT.PeriodEndDate  = '9999-12-31' )AND TGT.SOURCECODE = 'CRM';


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating ( 
[CustomerId]
,[CreditRatingAgencyId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[CreditRiskId]
,[CustomerCreditRatingNote]
,[RiskRatingTypeId]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
  SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
, NULL AS CreditRatingAgencyId
, SRC.PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
, '9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
, SRC.CreditRiskId AS CreditRiskId
, SRC.CustomerCreditRatingNote AS CustomerCreditRatingNote
, SRC.RiskRatingTypeId AS RiskRatingTypeId
, SRC.SourceCode
, SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
, 0 AS WorkFlowId
, 0 AS TaskRunId
, SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = SRC.SOURCECODE 
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT')



DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA;

END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMEROVERALLCREDITRATING_SEC] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
(
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
)
, 
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating
AS(
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartDate
    ,RISK_SCORE AS CreditRiskId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm 
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE as SourceCode
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
where BSC.ISLATEST = 1

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CreditRiskId)
))  HASHROW, CustomerId,  FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating 
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CreditRiskId)
))  HASHROW, CustomerId,  FinancialInstitutionId, SourceCode 
FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating WHERE PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' AND SourceCode = 'SEC'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
	,CASE
     WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndDate] = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31' AND TGT.SOURCECODE = 'SEC'	;


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[CreditRatingAgencyId]
,[PeriodStartDate]
,[PeriodEndDate]
,[CreditRiskId]
,[CustomerCreditRatingNote]
,[RiskRatingTypeId]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
Distinct
  SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
, NULL AS CreditRatingAgencyId
, SRC.PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
, '9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
, SRC.CreditRiskId AS CreditRiskId
, NULL AS CustomerCreditRatingNote
, NULL AS RiskRatingTypeId
, SRC.SourceCode
, SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
, 0 AS WorkFlowId
, 0 AS TaskRunId
, SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = SRC.SOURCECODE 
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('UPDATE','INSERT');



DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOverallCreditRating_DELTA;

END
